theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ζ : MultiVector P (n + 1)) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), (∀ β : Euclid P →L[ℝ] ℝ, ζ (ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin (β.smulRight α)) = β (∑ l : Fin P, ζ (ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin ((innerSL ℝ (EuclideanSpace.single l (1 : ℝ))).smulRight α)) • EuclideanSpace.single l (1 : ℝ))) ∧ ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), IsUnitOrientationOf ζ Q → (∑ l : Fin P, ζ (ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin ((innerSL ℝ (EuclideanSpace.single l (1 : ℝ))).smulRight α)) • EuclideanSpace.single l (1 : ℝ)) ∈ Q
